output.summary: Flowering herb native to forests from northeastern Mexico through Central and South America to northeastern Argentina. Its young red, green or purple stems are finely hairy, while its leaves are often vividly reddish-purple. Small vanilla-coloured, pom-pom-like flowers grow in compact clusters.
output.edibilityNote: It is harvested from the wild for regional use as food, although the parts and preparation are not specified.
